scope: Cycle audit of unchanged installed RTL; no lane or RTL changes made.

trace.phase_probe: Sample current KernelFrag FSM state before each tick; accumulate only batches observed from stage_write entry to emit exit; unchanged DMA replay verification remains enabled. Phase cycles count simulated ticks; instrumented replay wall time is not a performance comparison.

desktop_estimate.note: Two full bounding boxes, outward quad alignment; the current rasterizer emits even fully uncovered quads. Estimate, not measured 640x480 per-draw counters.
desktop_estimate.scope_limit: Different texture extent/cache behavior and host integration can change cycles per lane and ticks per second.
desktop_estimate.lower_bound_scope: Current uncoalesced staging transfers only: 11 full-line transactions per processed lane, 8 data beats per 64-byte line on a 64-bit AXI bus. Excludes all address/response, translation, shader and output work; not an achievable frame-cycle target.

optimization_candidates: Reject wholly uncovered quads while preserving all helper lanes of every nonempty quad and empty-draw retirement. Roughly half the background shader/staging lanes could be removed; gain requires implementation and pixel/cycle validation.

Coalesce or pipeline the eight staging writes and three readbacks per lane; each currently uses a serialized 64-byte line transaction for a four-byte word. Preserve CPU coherence and private-cache invalidations.
Make graphics lane count, shader VL, array offsets and bank sizes agree before enabling 16 graphics lanes; general-compute lane count does not widen graphics.
Texture sampler serializes active lanes; widen only after stage/texture bottlenecks are measured.
limitations: The 34,402,900 ticks cover the recorded guest workload, not a single desktop frame.
Per-phase results are exact for completed batches in this trace; background cycle totals above are estimates.
Existing simulator optimization plateau does not establish an RTL architecture optimum.
